name: The net maps' own pieces on generated layers
now: Surveyed over 24 areas (issue #505). On layers: CopyBot Comp's claws and BN4's Undernet's flames, cut from the maps' second tile layer with the panel they grip and MegaMan drawn behind them as in BN6 (src/map/sides.c), and the Underground's teal emblems. Found in the ROM and seen in the game: the Undernet's flames and Aquarium Comp's fish are tile animations the maps' GFXAnim lists write (tiles 726-737 and 1-12; tools/map_anims.py), which a map shows by setting those tile numbers.
left: Set the animated blocks on layers; the Aquarium's pillars (its pads are raised floor in its maps) and Robot Control's pipes; the other kinds on issue #505.
